OpenAI Models Advance Scientific Research in Mathematics and Physics

28 Oct 2026, 02:11 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Tech Desk · Source: www.aljazeera.com

1 min read

Key takeaways

Image: John Power · Photo source · Cropped to 16:9; original source image

In this article
  1. AI-Driven Scientific Breakthroughs
  2. Expert Scrutiny

AI-Driven Scientific Breakthroughs

OpenAI has reported that its artificial intelligence models successfully produced breakthroughs in harmonic analysis, complexity theory, and quantum field theory. Notably, the AI proved the local smoothing conjecture across all spatial dimensions, a long-standing challenge in harmonic analysis. Additionally, OpenAI claims to have disproved the Exponential Time Hypothesis and provided a rigorous proof for quantum chromodynamics.

Expert Scrutiny

Independent experts are currently reviewing the findings. While some mathematicians view the progress as a historic shift for theoretical research, computer scientists remain cautious, working to verify the validity of the reported complexity theory refutation. OpenAI is collaborating with external "shepherd" groups to interpret and publish these data sets, balancing rapid information sharing with academic peer review. The findings can be tracked through official company announcements at: https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/10/27/ai-makes-discoveries-in-mathematics-computer-science-physics-openai-says
